title: Industrial plant Ethernet
goal: Show a resilient industrial Ethernet control network isolated by an industrial DMZ.

rubric.must: Four managed switches visibly form a closed fiber ring.
An Industrial DMZ boundary visibly separates the historian and DMZ switch from the OT control zone.
IT and OT firewalls visibly form the security path into the DMZ.
SCADA server, two HMIs, and two PLCs are visibly connected to the control network.
Each ring segment visibly carries an MRP ring label.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG more clearly satisfies the closed fiber ring, DMZ separation, required device counts, and per-segment MRP labeling.
